model.title: A resolution recognizing the 80th anniversary of the Fullbright Program.

summary.text: The resolution would recognize the 80th anniversary of the Fulbright Program, which promotes international educational and cultural exchange. It aims to acknowledge the program's significance in fostering mutual understanding between the United States and other nations.
